Italics are used in WHO publications in the following ways: for the titles of books, journals and documents; for foreign words and expressions not in common use (including Latin species and genus names); for variables in mathematical expressions; for certain letters, prefixes and terms in scientific use; (sparingly) for words requiring special emphasis.
